[color=#D4D4D8]Give Pelican Town’s green-haired tea queen the portrait glow-up she deserves.

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Caroline HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b] replaces Caroline’s original portraits with a polished, semi-realistic HD redesign created for [b]Portraiture[/b].
[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]This version keeps Caroline instantly recognizable while leaning into a softer, more elegant, mature look with expressive green eyes, fuller features, glossy lips, flowing sage-green hair, and a warm feminine aesthetic that suits her personality beautifully.
[/color]

[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Cozy tea-room elegance with just a little extra main-character energy. 🌿✨[/color]

🎨 HEMPTRESS HD PORTRAIT STYLE
This mod is part of my growing collection of [b]Stardew Valley HD Portraits[/b].
My portrait redesigns focus on:
